facts.value: When HammerWait IASA reaches this check, ftCo_800C97A8 accepts input.lstick[0].x * facing_dir <= p_ftCommonData->x34. Equality qualifies; an unordered comparison does not. Success invokes the private HammerTurn entry helper and returns true, suppressing the subsequent ftCo_800C55CC check in HammerWait IASA. Failure returns false and permits that subsequent check. The wrapper does not independently test grounding or item possession.
facts.rationale: Repairs canonical field spelling and records the verified threshold and ordered caller behavior without relying on a rendered external alias.

evidence.why: Exact predicate and canonical input expression.

facts.value: Services the HammerTurn action's timed facing reversal. With a normal positive integral counter whose unit decrements reach zero, positive duration, and rotation enabled, its interpolation ends at the source's pi-based yaw before facing_dir is negated and HammerWait is entered. x2222_b6 suppresses yaw writes without suppressing decrement or completion. Initial zero skips the whole turn-specific path; fractional overshoot, large counters, and nonfinite values prevent an unconditional half-turn or completion guarantee.
facts.rationale: Replaces unconditional 180-degree presentation with the actual guards and floating-counter boundaries.

evidence.why: Nonzero guard, decrement, optional yaw, and terminal facing reversal.

facts.value: Unconditionally forwards gobj to ft_80084F3C. The immediate helper starts with ground_friction, scales it by friction_when_above_walk_speed only when ABS(gr_vel) > walk_max_vel, then calls ftCommon_ApplyFrictionGround followed by ftCommon_ApplyGroundMovement. Neither wrapper nor immediate helper explicitly changes motion state. Universal transitive state preservation and deceleration for arbitrary attribute values are not established.
facts.rationale: Replaces the absolute state-preservation assertion with verified local and immediate-callee behavior.

evidence.why: Strict scaling boundary and ordered calls, with no explicit transition.

facts.value: Successful shared facing-relative input acceptance invokes private HammerTurn entry and returns true. Anim always invokes shared Hammer processing, but turn-specific work requires nonzero mv.co.walk.fast_anim_frame: it resolves TransN, decrements the float counter, optionally writes yaw when x2222_b6 is clear, and reverses facing and enters HammerWait only if the decremented value is <= 0. Initial zero does not complete. IASA independently polls the shared Hammer jump handler without a counter gate and routes accepted input into HammerKneeBend. Phys and Coll delegate to common ground movement and HammerWait collision processing.
facts.rationale: Repairs the missing outer animation guard while preserving verified entry, completion, interruption, and delegation behavior without asserting compiled timer-overlay equivalence.

evidence.why: Complete owned entry and callback control flow.
